Warehouse Orderpicker/HLO - Den Hoorn -  €15,29 per uur - Logistiek - 36 uur Do you want to work as an HLO (Man Up) Orderpicker at the large logistics company Van der Helm? The job is done with a tall Combi Truck. The worker sits inside the cabin of the machine. The cabin is big enough, so the worker has space to sit and move safely. The machine can go very high, up to 12-16 meters. The worker goes up together with the cabin. Before going up, the worker puts an empty pallet on the forks. Sometimes there is a full pallet on the forks if it needs to be placed in the rack. When you are is high in the air, you takes boxes from the shelves by hand. The boxes can weigh between 15 and 20 kilos, depending on the product. The worker puts the boxes on the empty pallet or places full pallets into the rack. After finishing the work, the machine goes down. The worker drives the truck to another place in the warehouse.
